mathematical_bound_analysis.quadrature_resolution_effect: Coarse mesh underestimates gradient peak; fine mesh resolves higher gradient energy
mathematical_bound_analysis.reason: Under the strict non-healing constraint d_C4 >= d_donor and history monotonicity H_C4 >= H_donor, the AT2 functional cannot be arbitrarily reduced below its discrete C4 minimizer without either: (a) introducing artificial damage healing (violating irreversibility), or (b) applying post-hoc non-physical energy scaling (violating energy conservation), or (c) artificially flattening the crack-tip profile (violating governing phase-field PDEs). Because Package 113, 115, and 118 all independently converged to E_tot ~ 0.21671-0.21676 mJ (+2.008% to +2.030%) regardless of transfer pathway, this energy shift is an intrinsic discretization property of the AT2 regularization on nonmatching meshes, not an artifact of transfer.

finding: Independent reconstruction and rigorous variational analysis of Package 113 cross-mesh transfer confirms: 1. The original unrounded energy discrepancy evaluates to +2.00803158% (exceedance of +0.00803158 percentage points, 80.32 ppm, or ~17.06 nJ over the 2.000% threshold). 2. Component deconstruction confirms 71.98% of the excess is driven by AT2 regularized fracture energy resolution (+7.481% on C4 vs C3), while elastic energy passes (+0.697%). 3. Multi-experiment synthesis across Package 113 (+2.008%), Package 115 (+2.030%), and Package 118 (+2.030%) demonstrates that ANY physically admissible state transferred to C4 and re-equilibrated intrinsically settles at E_tot ~ 0.21671-0.21676 mJ. 4. Hypothesis H32 is quantitatively REJECTED: under the mandatory physical constraints of zero damage healing (d >= d_donor) and history preservation (H >= H_donor), no admissible damage projection can reduce the AT2 energy below its discrete fine-mesh equilibrium without violating irreversibility or variational consistency. 5. Therefore, the cross-mesh energy discrepancy cannot be resolved by projection tricks; it is an authentic discretization phenomenon. In accordance with governance rules, submission of an artificial HPC job is WITHHELD. The governing gate STAGE_C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED and classification P113_GATE_VALID_FAILURE remain strictly retained.
